newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait to launch second mobile phone company.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to launch second mobile phone company.

text.p: Kuwait will move a step closer to privatising its mobile telephone sector with the launch in October of a mobile telephone company to compete with the existing monopoly, Mobile Telephone Company (MTC), Tuesday's al-Qabas daily quoted Communications Minister Jassem al-Oun as saying.
He said the new firm would have capital of 30 million dinars ($99 million).

The state, represented by its investment arm Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), would take a 24 percent stake while the rest would be offered in a two-week public subscription starting on August 31, the newspaper reported.
As part of a plan to privatise the sector, Kuwait earlier this year allocated 10 million dinars to add capacity to its existing mobile telephone system.
Officials have said that MTC's monopoly would have to be ended before the state started shedding its stake of some 49 percent in the company.
